hooks.name: recipe_sources
hooks.neoforge: none (JEI's IRecipeTransferHandler with extra source slots, as Tinkers' Construct's crafting station takes from adjacent inventories)

rust_summary: the containers recipe placement into a mod menu type's crafting grid may also take ingredients from (`native_recipe_sources`).
doc_summary: `native_recipe_sources(player, menu, pos, sources)` is asked on the server when the recipe book or a recipe viewer (`native_place_recipe`, `native_transfer_recipe`) fills the crafting grid of a mod menu type (`crafting`, [mods.md](mods.md#menu-types)) open at `pos`: push the positions of block containers (chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers, droppers, mod containers) onto `sources`, and the placement takes ingredients from them after the player's inventory, as a crafting station takes them from the chests beside it. No answer keeps vanilla's placement from the inventory alone. Bundles need "hooks": @API:recipe_sources@.
